terrainDescription.zh: 北部與中部為廣大農業平原，南部為地中海型氣候，東南部有阿爾卑斯山脈、西南有庇里牛斯山。
terrainDescription.en: Vast agricultural plains across the north and center, a Mediterranean climate in the south, and mountains ringing the edges — the Alps in the southeast, the Pyrenees in the southwest.

plate.color: white background, black text, blue EU band with "F" on the left

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Round white post with a pointed top and a full reflector band (grey or red) — very recognizable and common; a less-common wedge-shaped variant with wide rectangular reflectors also exists

utilityPole.transformerMount: "Ladder/waffle" concrete poles with step-like indents; small blue rectangular plates on wooden/metal poles; diamond-shaped "French poletop" with three wires common atop ladder poles

historicalContext.zh: 法語源自拉丁語，全境統一使用法語與拉丁字母，路牌風格與辨識線索（如白色長虛線、藍色車牌條）在西歐鄰國中相對一致但仍可辨識。
historicalContext.en: French is a Romance language descended from Latin, used uniformly nationwide in the Latin alphabet — signage style and clues (like the long white dashed road lines and blue EU plate band) are broadly similar to Western European neighbors but still distinguishable.
